command: tools/d1_compare.py register-close-window --repo-root PROJECT --team TEAM --window-start UTC --window-end UTC
functional_change: Publish one immutable, future, team/managed-instance-scoped OD-P interval using the existing d1-register-interval snapshot and success receipt. The database supplies the receipt clock; retry returns the original receipt and commit. Adjacent ranges are allowed, overlap is rejected under a per-team lock. Both evidence records commit or roll back together.

scenarios: Concurrent identical official CLI requests return one receipt and original received time/commit.
Conflicting overlapping ranges fail. Touching ranges succeed. An unregistered interval in the past is refused.
A retry after the clock passes start returns its original record.
A failure between snapshot and receipt commits neither row.
The existing prepared-input selection ignores OD-P-only registrations with no formally registered book-age policy.
